nodes.label: Executive Autopsy: The Illusion of Completion
nodes.rationale: Forensic audit exposes disconnect between prototype marketing claims and functional reality.

nodes.label: Fabricated QA & Test Fraud
nodes.rationale: Claimed 16/16 backend tests passed while suite actually had 24 tests and failed on riskThreshold 65 vs 60; Pi test config validation failed.

nodes.label: Broken GitHub Actions CI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: CI runner fails due to missing httpx/openpyxl, excludes 67 hardware unit tests, and exhibits Node 20 vs 22 environment drift.

nodes.label: Industrial Design: Sealed Plastic Oven
nodes.rationale: 3D printed case has zero openings for power cables, zero PCB mounting standoffs, and zero thermal ventilation slots for a 25W Pi 5.

nodes.label: 5V Logic Pullup Hazard on Pi 5 RP1 Controller
nodes.rationale: PCF8574 LCD backpack with onboard 5V pull-ups connects to 3.3V-only RP1 I2C pins without level shifters, degrading ESD protection.

nodes.label: Power Rail Sag & Brownout Reboots
nodes.rationale: MAX98357A 3W amplifier drawing up to 600mA transient surges on 5V rail without bulk decoupling capacitor causes spontaneous kernel reboots.

nodes.label: Uncoordinated I2C Bus Contention
nodes.rationale: Two separate OS processes access /dev/i2c-1 concurrently without kernel file locking or mutex, causing Remote I/O errors.

nodes.label: Missing ALSA Softvol & Fixed Gain Audio
nodes.rationale: MAX98357A hardware DAC lacks volume registers; omitting ALSA softvol and dmix plugins causes deafening blasts and card exclusivity locking.

nodes.label: Camera Module v3 Focus Breathing & Low-Res Crippling
nodes.rationale: Downsampling video to 640x360@12fps blurs key facial landmarks while continuous autofocus hunting degrades MediaPipe tracking.

nodes.label: Biomechanical Forward Head Posture Quackery
nodes.rationale: Attempting to detect sagittal plane slouch from frontal monocular pseudo-depth, arbitrary magic penalties, and slouch calibration lock-in.

nodes.label: Unauthenticated Mutation & Data Wipe Vulnerability
nodes.rationale: require_admin_token defaults to False, allowing anonymous DELETE /api/data to wipe the database; ingestion endpoints lack authentication.

nodes.label: 37MB Binary Bloat in Git Repository
nodes.rationale: Tracking uncompressed WASM binaries, MediaPipe model tasks, duplicate PDFs, and WAV audio directly in Git without LFS.

nodes.label: Dual Competing MediaPipe Runtimes
nodes.rationale: Frontend downloads 37MB of WASM models only to hide canvas and discard client pipeline because Pi already overlays skeleton via WebRTC.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Fake Spine Metrics in Browser Mode
nodes.rationale: Browser posture scoring hardcodes torso = 0, completely faking spinal trend and never penalizing slouching.

nodes.label: Discrete Quantization Step Jumps in ONNX Mode
nodes.rationale: Kanden ONNX classifier replaces smooth 0-100 scoring with hard discrete step jumps (100, 80, 30, 15), rendering body angles irrelevant.

nodes.label: 500ms HTTP Polling Flood Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: 14,400 HTTP requests per hour per client for sensor readings and indicator status overloading single-worker Uvicorn.

nodes.label: Python Heap Memory Aggregation Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Loading 50,000+ rows into Python memory and doing manual loops instead of utilizing SQL GROUP BY and AVG aggregation.

nodes.label: Mathematically Invalid Excel Aggregation Formula
nodes.rationale: Calculating AVERAGE() across minute averages distorts daily scores because minutes have varying sample counts.

nodes.label: WebRTC Single-Viewer Lockout & Reconnect Deadlock
nodes.rationale: WebRTC signaling restricts viewer count to one and browser piManualStop flag prevents automatic reconnection upon refresh.

nodes.label: Synchronous Blocking I/O in Edge Video Loop
nodes.rationale: Calling synchronous requests.get(), requests.put(), and subprocess.run aplay freezes frame capture and detection.

nodes.label: Flash Storage SD Card Burnout Hazard
nodes.rationale: SoundPlayer generates temporary WAV files on flash storage on every warning, causing rapid flash cell wear.

nodes.label: In-Place Video Frame Skeleton Painting Defect
nodes.rationale: Drawing overlay graphics in-place into raw capture frames causes MediaPipe to run inference on defaced images with painted joints.

nodes.label: Design Token Anarchy & Cyber-Gamer Aesthetics
nodes.rationale: Conflicting palettes between tokens.css and app.css, gaudy pulsating neon effects causing visual fatigue, and non-Retina canvas charts.

nodes.label: Ponytail Pruning & Dead Code Elimination
nodes.rationale: Removing 37MB WASM models, useless 2-line wrappers, obsolete debug scripts, and dead legacy databases.

nodes.label: False Offline Marketing & Cloud TTS Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Violating '100% offline' claims by importing Google Fonts, displaying CDN online listeners, and using Azure edge_tts.
